recipes.name: Slow-cooked beef in red wine with mushrooms
recipes.method_note: Better the next day. It freezes well.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 150C.
Cut {{ing:beef-braising}} into large chunks. Toss in {{ing:flour-plain}}.
Brown in {{ing:olive-oil}} in a casserole, in batches. Lift out.
steps.note: Browning in batches stops the meat stewing grey.

steps.instruction: Add {{ing:onion-medium}}, {{ing:carrot-medium}} and {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}}. Fry 8 minutes, until soft.
Stir in {{ing:bay-leaf}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}}.
Add {{ing:wine-red}}, then {{ing:stock-cube}} crumbled into 300 ml water.
Return the meat. Cover with a lid.
Cook in the oven 3 hours, until the beef falls apart.
Scatter with chopped {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 150C.
Cut {{ing:chicken-thigh-boneless}} into large chunks.
Brown in {{ing:olive-oil}} in a casserole, in batches. Lift out.
steps.note: Browning in batches stops the meat stewing grey.

steps.instruction: Add {{ing:onion-large}}, {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:ginger-fresh}}. Fry 8 minutes, until soft.
Stir in {{ing:garam-masala}} and {{ing:turmeric-ground}}.
Add {{ing:chopped-tomatoes-tinned}} and {{ing:coconut-milk-tinned}}.
Return the meat. Cover with a lid.
Cook in the oven 2 hours, until the chicken is very tender.
Stir in {{ing:spinach}} until wilted. Scatter with {{ing:fresh-coriander}}.

recipes.name: Slow-cooked bean in red wine with mushrooms
recipes.method_note: Better the next day. It freezes well.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 150C.
Warm {{ing:olive-oil}} in a casserole on a medium heat.
Add {{ing:onion-medium}}, {{ing:carrot-medium}} and {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}}. Fry 8 minutes, until soft.
Stir in {{ing:bay-leaf}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}}.
Add {{ing:wine-red}}, then {{ing:stock-cube}} crumbled into 300 ml water.
Drain {{ing:butter-beans-tinned}}. Add to the casserole. Cover.
Cook in the oven 2 hours, until the sauce is thick and rich.
Scatter with chopped {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.
